title: Bumblebee wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- wings -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='30' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#bfe8ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-25 30 30)'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='30' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#bfe8ff' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(25 70 30)'/>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='26' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e6f7ff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-25 34 26)'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='26' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e6f7ff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(25 66 26)'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='30' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- stripes -->
    <path d='M25 52 Q50 44 75 52 L75 62 Q50 54 25 62 Z' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <path d='M26 72 Q50 64 74 72 L73 82 Q50 74 27 82 Z' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <!-- stripe lighter highlights for edges -->
    <path d='M25 52 Q50 44 75 52' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M26 72 Q50 64 74 72' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='20' fill='#ffd23f'/>
    <!-- sunglasses -->
    <rect x='30' y='31' width='16' height='12' rx='4' fill='#2b2b40' stroke='#6b6b8f' stroke-width='2'/>
    <rect x='54' y='31' width='16' height='12' rx='4' fill='#2b2b40' stroke='#6b6b8f' stroke-width='2'/>
    <rect x='45' y='35' width='10' height='4' fill='#2b2b40'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='33' x2='25' y2='30' stroke='#2b2b40' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='33' x2='75' y2='30' stroke='#2b2b40' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- sunglass shine -->
    <rect x='33' y='33' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
    <rect x='57' y='33' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
    <!-- antennae -->
    <line x1='42' y1='20' x2='36' y2='10' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='20' x2='64' y2='10' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='9' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='9' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M44 48 Q50 53 56 48' fill='none' stroke='#b06a00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- stinger -->
    <path d='M50 90 L46 96 L54 96 Z' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  </g>
</svg>
